worker_one: Cheap, weak labourers; each carries {{count, number}} resource. Good for padding an army or hauling plunder, not for fighting.
worker_other: Cheap, weak labourers; each carries {{count, number}} resources. Good for padding an army or hauling plunder, not for fighting.
warrior: Basic foot soldiers: cheap melee troops that fight whatever is closest.
scout: The fastest unit, needed for scouting (scouting battles are fought between scouts only). In a battle they hang back while other troops are still fighting.
pikeman: Melee spearmen built to stop horses: they deal ×{{multiplier}} damage to {{cavalry}} and {{cataphract}} units.
swordsman: Sturdy melee infantry with high defence; they deal ×{{multiplier}} damage to {{target}} units.
archer: Ranged foot troops with long reach; they shoot enemy ranged units ({{targets}}) first.
transporter_one: Supply wagons: each carries {{count, number}} resource, by far the most. They stay out of the fight while other troops remain, so pair them with an escort.
transporter_other: Supply wagons: each carries {{count, number}} resources, by far the most. They stay out of the fight while other troops remain, so pair them with an escort.
cavalry: Fast mounted troops; they deal ×{{multiplier}} damage to {{target}} units. Hurt by enemy {{abatis}}.
cataphract: Heavy armoured cavalry: tough and hard-hitting, they deal ×{{multiplier}} damage to {{target}} units. Hurt by enemy {{abatis}}.
ballista: Siege engine with long range and high attack; it shoots ranged units first and batters the walls when nothing else is in reach.
batteringRam: Siege engine with enormous life (it soaks up damage) that smashes the walls; slow.
catapult: The longest-range, hardest-hitting siege engine; devastating against walls and ranged units, but slow and fragile up close.
trap: Hidden pits: when attackers reach the last stretch before the walls, traps kill some of every group there and are used up. Takes {{space}} wall space.
abatis: Spiked barricades that only hit {{cavalry}} and {{cataphract}} units approaching the walls. Takes {{space}} wall space.
archerTower: Archers on the walls: they shoot attackers from range (the range grows with the {{walls}} level) and take only {{percent}}% damage. Improved by the research {{techs}}. Takes {{space}} wall space.
rollingLog: Logs rolled down on the strongest group of foot troops near the walls; used up. Takes {{space}} wall space.
trebuchet: Hurls rocks at the strongest attacking group within long range; used up. Takes {{space}} wall space.
